materialAnalysisExtracted: Seattle returns nine of 11 defensive starters after allowing a league-low 6.0 yards per pass attempt and recording 47 sacks in 2025; Maye enters with new top receivers. Silva projects Rhamondre Stevenson ahead of TreVeyon Henderson and flags Henderson’s pass-protection shortcomings versus Mike Macdonald’s complex pressure schemes; Seattle also allowed a league-low 3.7 yards per carry in 2025. The late-retrieved primary-page text materially upgrades the previously analysis-only record by adding Silva’s explicit Under 44.5 construction.
